2608.30652.title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
2608.30652.paper_summary: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. To address this gap, we introduce PyKEEN-NSX, an extension of PyKEEN, the popular KGE framework, that provides a modular engineered abstraction for negative sampling. The proposed architecture separates the generation of candidate negative pools, conditioned on an explicit context, from the selection strategy, enabling the development and integration of static, schema-aware and dynamic approaches within a consistent framework. Based on this abstraction, we implement six negative samplers, while remaining fully compatible with existing PyKEEN workflows and pipelines. As a proof of concept, we study negative availability across four datasets, showing that constrained pools frequently fall below the requested number of negatives, so that the encoded criterion is to a large extent replaced by the random fallback that supplements them.
2608.30652.paper_summary_zh: 嵌入方法因其在知識圖譜（KGs）上的鏈接預測和/或三元分類任務中的可擴展性而變得流行。嵌入模型的訓練依賴於三元組的正樣本和負樣本。然而，由於KGs通常僅包含正斷言，負樣本是通過負採樣策略人工生成的，這些策略從簡單的隨機損壞到利用結構、語義或嵌入信息的更複雜方法不等。高級負採樣器的設計和實施仍然具有挑戰性，因為大多數流行的知識圖譜嵌入（KGE）庫僅支持基本策略，並且缺乏統一的框架來開發更高級和自定義的解決方案。為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了PyKEEN-NSX，這是流行的KGE框架PyKEEN的一個擴展，提供了一個模塊化的負採樣工程抽象。所提出的架構將基於明確上下文的候選負池的生成與選擇策略分開，使得在一致的框架內開發和整合靜態、模式感知和動態方法成為可能。基於這一抽象，我們實現了六個負採樣器，同時與現有的PyKEEN工作流程和管道完全兼容。作為概念驗證，我們研究了四個數據集中的負可用性，顯示受限池經常低於所請求的負樣本數量，因此編碼標準在很大程度上被隨機回退所取代，以補充它們。
